description: Bulk-add players to a tournament's roster (organizer step 2, right after create_tournament; needs that tournament's manage_code). Each player needs a name; email, phone and division are optional per player. The same email may appear on more than one row — one person entering two events takes two roster rows, each with its own player id — so set a different division per row for the two entries; within the same division a repeated email is skipped as a duplicate. This roster is what generate_bracket seeds from. Returns how many were imported and which rows were skipped, and why.

players.description: Player objects to add: {name (required, max 40 characters), email?, phone?, division?}. Same email in a different division imports as a second row. Max 500 per call

name: import_players
